Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. I'm Aditya (solutions/infrastructure) — I'll cover the technical KMS details below and attach a short diagram and the KMS matrix. High level answers first, then specifics: 

High level:
- In-transit: TLS 1.3 enforced for all API and web traffic. Mutual TLS available for Private deployments.
- At-rest: AES-256 encryption for all persistent storage and object stores. Token/KV caches are encrypted in memory and never persisted unencrypted.
- SOC2: the attached report is a redacted summary; we can provide a bridge letter and full auditor contact under NDA if needed.
- CMK support: Supported for Dedicated and Private deployments. For our hosted SaaS offering we support two modes: (1) Managed keys (default) where Redwood manages keys in our cloud KMS; (2) Customer-managed keys via a tenant-specific cloud KMS integration (BYOK) for enterprise customers on a contract. HSM-backed (FIPS 140-2/3) key stores are supported when using customer's own HSM/KMS or in our Private appliance offering.

Specifics you asked: 
- "Do you offer CMK for hosted (SaaS) deployments?"
  Yes — for enterprise customers we can enable CMK where your KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or Azure Key Vault) is integrated and keys are created/rotated under your control. This requires an onboarding checklist and minimal agent/connector setup.

- "Is the KMS HSM-backed and who manages the keys?"
  If you bring your own KMS/HSM, you retain sole control and key material never leaves your KMS. If keys are stored in Redwood-managed KMS, we can provide an HSM-backed customer partition for dedicated/private environments; keys are then rotated under policy but Redwood's org has management capabilities — this is the managed mode.

- "Can our KMS be used (BYOK) or do you require provider KMS?"
  BYOK is supported. For the hosted SaaS mode we support cross-account key grants or external key wrapping depending on the cloud provider. For Private/Dedicated we mount the customer's KMS/HSM directly.

- Data residency: yes — logs, encryption metadata, and audit logs can be restricted to US regions for customers on Dedicated/Private plans; for hosted customers we offer region selection and contractual commitments.

Attachments: short KMS architecture diagram and a KMS support matrix (see attached).

- Olivia: If you're good, we can schedule a 30-min technical call next Tue (Mar 2) with our infra engineer to walk through the diagram and the connector requirements.

Thanks,
